questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'UBIQUITOUS'?
questions.explanation: Ubiquitous means appearing or being present everywhere at the same time.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:

choices.a: Neither of the boys are coming.
choices.b: Neither of the boys is coming.
choices.c: Neither of the boys were coming.
choices.d: Neither of the boys have coming.

questions.explanation: 'Neither' is singular, so it takes a singular verb 'is'.

questions.question: If 'all writers are artists' and 'some artists are painters', which is true?
questions.explanation: The statements don't establish any direct relationship between writers and painters.

questions.question: HOSPITAL : PATIENT :: SCHOOL : ?
questions.explanation: A hospital serves patients; a school serves students.
